title: Multiscale replay: A robust algorithm for stochastic variational inequalities with a Markovian buffer
summary: We introduce the Multiscale Experience Replay (MER) algorithm for solving a class of stochastic variational inequalities (VIs) in settings where samples are generated from a Markov chain and we have access to a memory buffer to store them. Rather than uniformly sampling from the buffer, MER utilizes a multi-scale sampling scheme to emulate the behavior of VI algorithms designed for independent and identically distributed samples, overcoming bias in the de facto serial scheme and thereby accelerating convergence.
